market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from CPI-driven Fed hike expectations, oil volatility, and bond selloff. Dow rallied on surprise data but weekly losses likely. Next week's Fed decision is critical. Oil above $100 sustains inflation pressure. Expect elevated VIX and sector rotation toward energy and defensives.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle supports tech earnings but debt-fueled spending raises 2027 correction risk. Infrastructure buildout (fiber, data centers, space) provides multi-year tailwinds. Inflation likely sticky through 2027 given energy and trade war dynamics. Fed may hike 2-3 more times before pausing. Consumer spending under structural pressure.
